summary: This PEP proposes adding a new cyclic garbage collector to CPython. The new collector will be both generational and incremental. Collections will alternate: a young collection, then an (incremental) old collection, then a young collection, and so on.

title: Python Language Summit 2026
summary: The 2026 Python Language Summit was hosted in Kraków, Poland as part of EuroPython 2026. There were 15 talks covering free-threading, Rust, garbage collection, type annotations, and more.

title: Lightning Talks (Python Language Summit 2026)
summary: Lightning talks on a one-time ABI break, safer interruptions, EktuPy (Scratch but Python), an AGENTS.md file for CPython, and a call to read PEP 836.

title: Rust for CPython (Python Language Summit 2026)
summary: David Hewitt shares a status update, first module, and potential acceptance criteria for the Rust for CPython project

title: Memory Snapshots for CPython (Python Language Summit 2026)
summary: Hood Chatham proposes memory snapshots and an initialization phase for speedier Python startups

title: Memory Buffer Protocol (Python Language Summit 2026)
summary: Nathan Goldbaum proposes safe concurrent access through buffer leases and custom data types for the Python Buffer Protocol.

title: Garbage Collection: Generational? Incremental? Both! (Python Language Summit 2026)

title: One namespace to namespace them all (Python Language Summit 2026)
